annotations.title: P-Video Avatar talking head from a photo

description: Turn one portrait into a lip-synced talking video: send your own MP3 or WAV voice, or a script it speaks in one of 30 voices. 720p, up to 20 seconds. Compared with other video tools: mid-priced, and one of the most used right now. Price: from $0.339 per video up to 10 seconds, charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 10 $0.339, 20 $0.676 (default 10). One call = one talking video up to 10 seconds (up to 20 seconds costs more).

audio.description: Your own speech as an MP3 or WAV URL; the video is as long as the audio. Use this or voice_script

image.description: Portrait of the person who speaks, the first frame (https URL, jpg, png or webp)

max_seconds.description: Longest the video can be; sets the price. Longer audio or scripts are refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 10

negative_prompt.description: What you do not want, e.g. subtitles or text

video_prompt.description: How the person looks and moves while speaking

voice_prompt.description: How to say it: tone, pace, accent

voice_script.description: Exact words to say, spoken by the chosen voice, when you send no audio (about 2.3 words a second)

name: video-p-video-avatar
